package aiprompt

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
)

func TestGenerateLessonUsesTypedConfidentialContract(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.URL.Path != "/api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential" || request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "secret" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected request: %s token=%q", request.URL.Path, request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		}
		var body map[string]any
		if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if body["template_code"] != templateCode || body["idempotency_key"] != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected contract body: %#v", body)
		}
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{
          "execution_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
          "idempotency_key":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
          "template_code":"course.lesson-content.v1",
          "template_version":1,
          "provider_code":"openai",
          "provider_model":"gpt-test",
          "language_code":"ru",
          "response_schema_code":"course.lesson-content.v1",
          "parsed_response":{
            "description_markdown":"Описание",
            "examples":[{"title":"Пример","description_markdown":"Тело","primary_stack":"go","stacks":["go"],"target_concepts":["go.variables"]}],
            "knowledge_checks":[{"title":"Проверка","description_markdown":"Вопрос","expected_answers":["Ответ"]}]
          },
          "cached":false,
          "created_at":"2026-09-01T12:00:00Z",
          "expires_at":"2026-09-08T12:00:00Z"
        }`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	result, err := client.GenerateLesson(context.Background(), domainservice.LessonGenerationInput{
		CourseContext: map[string]any{"goal_code": "go.backend"}, Language: "ru",
		Lesson: domain.PlannedLesson{Code: "variables", Title: "Переменные"},
	}, "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("generate lesson: %v", err)
	}
	if result.DescriptionMarkdown != "Описание" || len(result.Examples) != 1 || len(result.KnowledgeChecks) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected result: %#v", result)
	}
}

func TestGenerateLessonMapsConfidentialContractErrors(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name          string
		status        int
		body          string
		wantDomainErr error
		wantStatusErr string
	}{
		{
			name:          "missing template",
			status:        http.StatusNotFound,
			body:          "confidential template not found",
			wantStatusErr: "ai prompt returned status 404",
		},
		{
			name:          "idempotency conflict",
			status:        http.StatusConflict,
			body:          `{"error":{"code":"idempotency_conflict"}}`,
			wantDomainErr: domain.ErrConflict,
		},
		{
			name:          "invalid confidential input",
			status:        http.StatusBadRequest,
			body:          "invalid confidential execution request",
			wantDomainErr: domain.ErrValidation,
		},
		{
			name:          "invalid generated structure",
			status:        http.StatusUnprocessableEntity,
			body:          "invalid confidential execution",
			wantDomainErr: domain.ErrValidation,
		},
		{
			name:          "invalid provider output",
			status:        http.StatusBadGateway,
			body:          "provider returned invalid structured output",
			wantStatusErr: "ai prompt returned status 502",
		},
		{
			name:          "execution unavailable",
			status:        http.StatusServiceUnavailable,
			body:          "confidential execution unavailable",
			wantStatusErr: "ai prompt returned status 503",
		},
	}

	for _, testCase := range tests {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
				if request.Method != http.MethodPost || request.URL.Path != "/api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential" {
					t.Errorf("unexpected request: %s %s", request.Method, request.URL.Path)
				}
				if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "secret" {
					t.Errorf("missing AI Prompt internal authorization header")
				}
				writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				writer.WriteHeader(testCase.status)
				_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(testCase.body))
			}))
			defer server.Close()

			client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.GenerateLesson(context.Background(), domainservice.LessonGenerationInput{
				CourseContext: map[string]any{"goal_code": "go.backend"}, Language: "ru",
				Lesson: domain.PlannedLesson{Code: "variables", Title: "Переменные"},
			}, "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected AI Prompt contract error")
			}
			if testCase.wantDomainErr != nil {
				if !errors.Is(err, testCase.wantDomainErr) {
					t.Fatalf("error = %v, want %v", err, testCase.wantDomainErr)
				}
				return
			}
			if err.Error() != testCase.wantStatusErr {
				t.Fatalf("error = %v, want %q", err, testCase.wantStatusErr)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGenerateLessonRejectsUntypedResponseDrift(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{
          "execution_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
          "idempotency_key":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
          "template_code":"course.lesson-content.v1",
          "template_version":1,
          "provider_code":"openai",
          "provider_model":"gpt-test",
          "language_code":"ru",
          "response_schema_code":"course.lesson-content.v1",
          "parsed_response":{},"cached":false,
          "created_at":"2026-09-01T12:00:00Z","expires_at":"2026-09-08T12:00:00Z",
          "unexpected":true
        }`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "secret", HTTPClient: &http.Client{Timeout: time.Second}}
	_, err := client.GenerateLesson(context.Background(), domainservice.LessonGenerationInput{
		CourseContext: map[string]any{"goal_code": "go.backend"}, Language: "ru",
		Lesson: domain.PlannedLesson{Code: "variables", Title: "Переменные"},
	}, "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected strict response rejection")
	}
}
